instruction: Consider the clubs relegated from the German Bundesliga at the end of the 2022/23 season and at the end of the 2023/24 season. Of those clubs, which has the most members? Answer with the club name.

provenance.source_benchmark: AssistantBench (Yoran et al., 2024); BrowseComp (Wei et al., 2025)
provenance.construction_method: Relegated clubs across two seasons plus a membership comparison, parallel aggregation.
provenance.difficulty_axis: three distinct sources aggregated in parallel

verification.memorization_no_tool: pending (must be non-memorized on the strongest model used)
